hamburg-north-german-escapes-north-sea-d.title: North Sea Dikes and St. Peter-Ording Long Day
hamburg-north-german-escapes-north-sea-d.slogan: A 357 km loop out of Hamburg north-west edge
hamburg-north-german-escapes-north-sea-d.story: Flat, windy, wide and much better than the map suggests. The best part sits around Büsum harbour stop, St. Peter-Ording beach edge, Eider barrage viewpoint, while Itzehoe fuel gate and Husum food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt.

sections.advice: Use Hamburg north-west edge → Itzehoe fuel gate as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: Itzehoe fuel gate → Husum food stop rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.

sections.advice: St. Peter-Ording beach edge → Eider barrage viewpoint rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.

sections.advice: Eider barrage viewpoint → Büsum harbour stop can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

sections.advice: Büsum harbour stop → Back to Hamburg is the reward section in Hamburg. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

places-abrigo-del-arquero-abric-d-ermite.story: 268 km from Bordón to Bordón, about 4 h 37 of riding. The stops in between: Barranc del Puig- Abric I, Abric d'Ermites I and back through Barranc del Puig- Abric I. The highest point is about 1,250 m. The line favours views over speed.
